name: lit-fetch-ladder
description: Fetch papers for a literature survey, open access first: discovery, open-access download, a headless browser, then the same browser carrying your library login, with prompt-injection safeguards enforced as hooks.

contact_email.title: Contact email
contact_email.description: Sent only to OpenAlex and Unpaywall, which ask for a contact address (Unpaywall requires one).

proxy_mode.title: Library access mode
proxy_mode.description: ezproxy-host: your library proxy rewrites hostnames (www-example-com.<suffix>). none: your network is already entitled (campus or VPN), no proxy and no saved login.

proxy_suffix.title: Library proxy suffix
proxy_suffix.description: The part your library's proxy adds to publisher hostnames, e.g. proxy.library.example.edu. Your library's website, or your Zotero / Lean Library settings, list it.

proxy_login_url.title: Library sign-in URL
proxy_login_url.description: The address that starts your library sign-in, e.g. https://login.proxy.library.example.edu/login?url=https://www.example.com/

user_agent.title: Browser user-agent (optional)
user_agent.description: Leave empty for Playwright's default. A normal desktop string gets past soft bot checks on some publisher pages; it does not defeat real bot protection and is not meant to.

cap_burst.title: Library page loads per burst
cap_burst.description: Authenticated page loads allowed before a 15-minute pause resets the count. At most 20.

cap_daily.title: Library page loads per 24 hours
cap_daily.description: Rolling 24-hour limit on authenticated page loads. At most 60.

pages_per_paper.title: Page loads per approved paper
pages_per_paper.description: A batch may use at most this many authenticated page loads per paper you approved. At most 8.
